'''Dorok's Pirate Fleet''' was an organization led by [[Dorok Zalaster]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] who operated within the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. The Pirate Fleet consisted of a captured [[Guardian 334-class light cruiser|''Guardian 334''-class light cruiser]], ''[[The Last Thing]]'', and eight [[Redthorn-class scout ship|''Redthorn''-class scout ships]]. Zalaster also had thirty-four [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] under his command, as well as a network of [[Spy/Legends|spies]].
